subject.title: fix(control-ui): WebSocket connects to wrong gateway when two share an origin

question: Should this PR be the canonical fix for the same-origin Control UI storage fallback bug, accepting its tested rule that preserves remote endpoints plus root/current-base /ws while rejecting other same-host legacy paths as unsafe sibling pollution?
rationale: The code path is compatibility-sensitive persisted browser state, and the correct treatment of same-host legacy custom paths is a product/upgrade boundary rather than a purely mechanical correctness issue.

options.title: Accept Tested Boundary
options.body: Merge after CI is refreshed, keeping the current rule that blocks same-host sibling paths while preserving the covered custom endpoint cases.

options.title: Broaden Migration First
options.body: Ask for an additional maintainer-approved rule and regression test if same-origin custom endpoint paths beyond the covered /ws shapes must survive upgrade.

options.title: Choose Another Candidate
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers prefer a competing same-root-cause branch as the canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept Tested Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after CI is refreshed, keeping the current rule that blocks same-host sibling paths while preserving the covered custom endpoint cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main ownership evidence for the Control UI settings module points to steipete via the file introduction/refactor commit.
